findings.question: q-biology-human-anatomy-physiology-0017
findings.quote: It converts every fat molecule into protein.
findings.problem: This is a throwaway distractor rather than a plausible CET-level misconception, contrary to the style guide. A student can reject wholesale conversion of fat into protein without knowing how bile helps enzymes digest fat.
findings.fix: Replace it with a plausible confusion between bile and pancreatic enzymes, such as “It releases lipase into the small intestine,” and update its note.
